row.notes: lea r9,[rnd_dept_icons_small] (7 bytes) in Career_Bind_UpgradeCard, after mov [rsp+0x20],rbx and before call Ne_Format_String("%s.%s.%s", [param_5+0x660], atlas, frame). The frame rbx comes from the part TYPE t (byte from 0x1429bd5d0(param_2), 3 if absent), not a department byte: 0-2 engine, 3-6 chassis, 7-10 aero, 11-18 maintenance set bpl=1 and rbx = name table 0x14571bcc0[[rsp+0x48]] (0x1417f8758); t>18 sets [rsp+0x48]=5, bpl=0 and rbx = "error_department" (0x1417f876a). The Tyres types 19-22 fall into t>18. The hook replaces [rsp+0x20] when it is the string "error_department".
